Directory research 2026-10-04: The band spells its name "Beernutz" (one word) on its own site; our listing uses "Beer Nutz". The Facebook icon on the band's own site points to a broken Wix address (facebook.com/beernutzmusicok.com/wix); the Facebook page beernutzforbeer was matched by name and Long Island show posts, not by a link from the site. Booking is through the contact form at the bottom of the home page; no public email or phone.
description: A Long Island cover band that plays classic rock, party rock and dance hits from the 70s, 80s and 90s at bars, breweries and beach venues. The six-piece lineup has a female lead singer, guitars, keyboards and drums.
